title: Ticket CLI: long text from files, resolve todos and unknowns, run from any directory, show, review guard
description: Backticks in long --description strings were eaten by the shell and five tickets were repaired by hand; update can add todos and unknowns but not close them, so an agent hand-edited CRAW-28.json; the script must run from the tickets repo and one whole update vanished when run from a worktree; hard-coded content/ paths broke when tickets moved to done/; and mark done accepted DONE while the worktree was uncommitted (report items 9, 25, 31). Changes to generate_board.py: every long text option accepts @path to read the value from a file and create accepts --from-json <file> for a whole ticket; --resolve-todo N and --resolve-unknown N remove entries by index (printing what was removed); the script locates the tickets repo from its own location so it runs from any cwd, and pyproject exposes it as a uv tool named tix with the same subcommands; show <ID> prints a ticket resolving content/ versus done/; help text says which options are repeatable; mark done refuses when a worktree named like the ticket exists under any known repo and has uncommitted changes or commits not on the main branch, suggesting mark review instead; mark review is unchanged. Never hand-edit ticket JSON; extend the script.
definition-of-done: 1. create --description @file with backticks and dollar signs in the file round-trips exactly. 2. update --resolve-todo 2 removes the second todo and prints it. 3. tix show CRAW-1 works from /tmp and finds the ticket under done/. 4. mark done on a ticket whose worktree is dirty refuses; mark review succeeds. 5. help marks repeatable options. 6. Tests for each in the repo's test file; board regenerates.
testing-plan: 1. pytest on a temporary copy of the tickets tree covering each DoD item. 2. Manual: install with uv tool install --editable and run tix show from another directory.
unknowns: Baseline: the tool-9 worktree was cut from main, which does not have the REVIEW-state work that sits uncommitted in the ixdar-tickets main checkout. I copied the live generate_board.py into the worktree before editing, so the worktree file is live-plus-TOOL-9 and nothing is lost, but landing it will meet the main checkout local modification to the same file. Confirm you want to reconcile that by hand, or say whether ixdar-tickets should follow the ai-workspace model where the main checkout uncommitted state is the current tooling and agents edit it directly.

Should CLAUDE.md and the ticket briefs switch from uv run python generate_board.py to tix once this lands, and should tix be installed from the main checkout with uv tool install --editable alongside wt? I uninstalled the verification install because it pointed at the worktree.

mark done --force and update --status DONE --force exist as the escape hatch for work that has already landed while a stale worktree lingers. Say if you would rather the guard be absolute with no --force.
changes-made: generate_board.py: every free-text option (create --title/--description/--definition-of-done/--testing-plan/--todo/--unknown, update --append-description/--definition-of-done/--append-definition-of-done/--testing-plan/--append-testing-plan/--add-todo/--add-unknown/--add-changes) now resolves @PATH through an argparse type, with @- for stdin and @@ for a literal leading at-sign. Verified byte-exact: a description file holding backticks, dollar-HOME, dollar-brace-VAR, a dollar-paren command substitution and a newline round-trips into the JSON unchanged.

generate_board.py: create --from-json FILE (or -) builds a whole ticket from JSON, accepting both hyphen and underscore spellings of definition-of-done, testing-plan, related-files and blocked-by. Command-line options override scalars and extend lists. The seven required fields are no longer argparse required=True, so they can come from the file; a missing one exits 1 naming every missing flag.

generate_board.py: update --resolve-todo N and --resolve-unknown N remove one-based entries and print each removed line plus the remaining count. Both are repeatable and index the pre-update list, so --resolve-todo 1 --resolve-todo 3 on four todos leaves entries 2 and 4. An out-of-range index exits 1 printing the numbered entries and writes nothing.

generate_board.py: the tickets root is discovered by walking up from the script file to the nearest ancestor holding content/ and generate_board.py, overridable with IXDAR_TICKETS_ROOT; set_root_dir lets tests point every store path at a temporary tree. Verified tix show CRAW-1 and tix priorities --epic TOOL run from /tmp.

pyproject.toml added: hatchling, project.scripts tix = generate_board:main, only-include generate_board.py. Verified with uv tool install --editable . --force, then tix show CRAW-1 from /tmp printing the ticket out of done/CRAW/. The tool was uninstalled afterwards because that editable install pointed at the tool-9 worktree, which land removes; install it from the main checkout once this lands.
generate_board.py: show gained --indices, which prints todos and unknowns numbered so the numbers can be handed straight to --resolve-todo/--resolve-unknown.

generate_board.py: mark done now refuses while a worktree named after the lowercased ticket id exists under CODE_DIR/REPO/.claude/worktrees/ for Ixdar, ai-workspace or ixdar-tickets and git status --porcelain is non-empty or the branch has commits not on main or master. The message names each worktree with its counts and says to mark review instead; --force overrides. update --status DONE is guarded identically. Verified live: mark done TOOL-9 exited 1 reporting 5 uncommitted files in the tool-9 worktree, mark review TOOL-9 exited 0.

generate_board.py: the code directory holding the known repos is discovered by walking up from the tickets root rather than taking its parent, because the script can itself be running from a checkout inside .claude/worktrees/ where the parent is the worktrees directory. IXDAR_CODE_DIR overrides. This was a real bug caught during verification: before the fix the guard found no worktrees at all when run from the worktree copy.

generate_board.py: an _annotate_option_help pass walks every subparser and appends Repeatable to each append-action option and Accepts @FILE to each @-capable one, so the two notes cannot drift from the behaviour; the shared epilog on the root, create and update parsers explains both syntaxes and says the repo is found from the script.

generate_board.py: the argv handling moved into main(argv) plus _dispatch, so the same code serves tix and python generate_board.py; UnmergedWorktreeError, IndexError, ValueError and OSError are turned into a one-line stderr message and exit 1 instead of a traceback.

test_generate_board.py added: 24 tests, all passing under python3 -m unittest test_generate_board and uv run --with pytest --no-project pytest test_generate_board.py (0.5 s). Each test copies content/ and done/ into a temporary root and calls set_root_dir and set_code_dir, so the live board is never touched. Coverage: @file round-trip with shell-hostile characters, @@ escaping, missing-file error, --from-json, missing required fields, resolve-todo single and repeatable and out-of-range, resolve-unknown, show from done/ with --indices, root discovery, mark done refusal on dirty and on ahead-of-main, mark review success, mark done success when clean, --force, update --status DONE guarded, worktree lookup across the three repos, non-git directory, the two help-annotation invariants, and board regeneration.
.gitignore: added __pycache__/ and .pytest_cache/, and removed the committed __pycache__/generate_board.cpython-311.pyc that every run of the script was rewriting into the proposed diff.
